endonym.gloss: the lakes, used for the whole world

description.value: A cold rock world with a thick nitrogen atmosphere and hydrocarbon lakes across its northern third, fed by a methane cycle that includes weather, rivers and a slow organic drizzle. Cryovolcanic plains cover the south. It sits on the returning limb of the Backswing, in a region the encounter swept nearly clean, so its night sky is close to empty. What is known of its inhabitants comes from material traded through the outer station; nobody has met them.
Mrzel svet z jezeri tekočega metana in skoraj praznim nočnim nebom.

Um mundo rochoso e frio, de atmosfera densa de azoto e lagos de hidrocarbonetos por todo o seu terço norte, alimentados por um ciclo do metano que inclui meteorologia, rios e um lento chuvisco orgânico. Planícies criovulcânicas cobrem o sul. Situa-se no braço de retorno do Backswing, numa região que o encontro varreu quase por completo, pelo que o seu céu noturno é quase vazio. O que se sabe dos seus habitantes vem de material trocado através da estação exterior; ninguém se encontrou com eles.

atmosphere.value: Nitrogen with four per cent methane at 1.7 bar, orange with photochemical haze. Cold enough to ruin an unprotected hand in seconds; the pressure, on its own, is almost hospitable.

biosphere.value: Life is present: 1 catalogued species (Kerf Lake Dwellers) and 1 recorded non-sapient organism. The survey is not claimed to be complete.

notes.value: The night sky here holds fourteen naked-eye stars. The photometric standard field had to be re-selected twice before one could be found with enough stars in it to be a field.
